name: Flock Of Feather Fiends
descr: A flock of undead crow corpses, eyes aglow with necroplasmic light.

data.motivesAndTactics: Caw incessantly, claw faces, flutter through the air, peck eyes

features.name: Horde (1d6+1)
features.text: When the Flock has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals **1d6+1** magic damage instead.

features.name: Maddening Cacophony
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Very Close range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must spend a Hope or become _Vulnerable_ until they deal damage to the Flock or the Flock is defeated.
